rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
A veteran in the struggle to reclaim Elven glory, nobody enters the forest without his knowledge.

Modeus 
"It is time. The humans destroy themselves, but there is still purity elsewhere to be soiled. The Elves! We will pull them screaming from their wretched forest and set their homes ablaze."

Succubus 
"The forest is huge, how do you expect to find them all? Even a fire would not reach them all before they could flee."

Modeus 
"I've called brother Fareum from the blackest pits for that purpose. He is weak...a creature of his power cannot exist for long away from Bethrezen. Dark obelisks now litter the Elven lands. Fareum will use them to burn everything."

Fareum 
"Yes. I can feel their presence. They are far from here. Far to the south. I must leave at once."

Fareum 
"Where are you, little ones? Perhaps this will draw you out?"

Modeus 
"Fareum has done it! See how the forest cowards flee into the Dwarven lands? Bethrezen will reward us for our actions here!"

Dwarf King 
"The filthy Elves march towards our lands by order of their black-hearted god. We must prepare for invasion. There will be glorious battles ahead, lads!"

Thief 
"Sire, the demons approach as well! Perhaps they unite against us?  We cannot face two armies unless we use more...subtle...methods."

Dwarf King 
"I don't even know what you're going to propose and I don't like it."

Alchemist 
"We've been discussing this...we can concoct a horrible poison to destroy their armies in their own homes. Glorious? No. But we have little choice."

Thief 
"There is a place far northeast of here where a vile fountain bubbles from the ground. Everything around it quickly rots away. If we can collect a small amount of this poison, we can poison the water supply of the Elves near their capital city."

Alchemist 
"I am convinced this substance will also weaken the demons, should it be spilled into their own unholy well."

Dwarf King 
"Do it, then. If this poison is as terrible as you claim, whoever fetches it will surely become sick. Such foul regions will also be home to terrible creatures. It will be a noble sacrifice."

Alchemist 
"I have lined several old scroll cases so that they may transport the substance. Once we use one to sample the well, I will be able to duplicate it within our own city. If we fail to reach the enemy, there will be more poison ready."

Alchemist 
"That's it! Now that we've got a sample, we will fill all of the scroll cases with the same poison. We must get them to the enemy wells!"

Alchemist 
"There! The Elves' well! Quickly, pour in the poison!"

Thief 
"It is done! We must leave this cursed forest."

Alchemist 
"Such an unholy place! Quickly, empty the poison into the well!"

Thief 
"It's working! The demons have been infected! We should sneak away before they realize we are responsible!"

Alchemist 
"Both armies have been poisoned, Sire! It won't belong before they succumb to it. We have halted the invasion!"

Dwarf King 
"Fine work, you do us all proud! Someone fetch these brave Dwarves a drink! No, two drinks!"

Sage 
"We've lost too many! We must stop sending our children to their graves! We will not give them our forests without a fight!"

The Legions must bring the demon Fareum to five obelisks within the Elven lands. 
The Elves have lost. 
The Dwarves must retrieve a poison and pollute the wells of both enemies.

Osbil 
"The Dwarven Altar. This must be it!"

Queen Illenese 
"By Gallean, they've done it. We will rebuild our homes within the heart of Dwarven territory! I venture those poor demons will have to report their failure to Bethrezen."

Queen Illenese 
"You have fought bravely, my children. You have kept our enemies out of our lands. Even now the fires grow dim  in our forests and the Dwarves retreat to their mountains."

Theurgist 
"The Demons approach our forests. Soon they will set it aflame and we will have nowhere to flee. We must abandon this place at once!"

Sylph 
"And where will we go? The Dwarves will never let us retreat into their mountains! We've had nothing but hostility returned when we have tried to speak with them!"

Theurgist 
"We have no choice but to push past them. The Demons will send minions into our lands to burn them. I suspect the obelisks that have sprung throughout the forests are their sources of power; we must keep them away from the obelisks!"

Gladeshadow 
"The Dwarves are planning something as well. I was not able to move near enough to hear their intentions, but we must be wary of any Dwarves in our forest."

Theurgist 
"It's obvious we have no future in this place. We will send nine tribe leaders to scout ahead into Clans territory. Once four of them have reported back that the route is safe, we can move. Otherwise, we must simply try to survive."
